text: Yup yup I mean, it made complete sense.... But saw some lovely depictions of it at the Acropolis museum, while in Greece last week Also realized, when visiting this ancient auditorium called "the Odeion of Herodotus Atticus" in the Acropolis complex that.... It was a place where Odes would be performed for the crowds...  Odes were originally meant to be performed rather than silently read-often accompanied by lyre or chorus. Performances of odes frequently took place at odeions (or odea), specially built roofed theaters for musical and poetic performnances in Greek and Roman cities.
